snippet.title: Starlathe — Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Command your ship and fleet in a galaxy that truly lives: 150 sectors where six factions mine, haul, trade, build and wage war whether you're there or not. Trade it, rob it, defend it — or forge your own fleet and carve out your place in it. Play solo or in online co-op.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5090060/Starlathe/
